about:
OEM Car Parts USA operates from Brooklyn, New York, where it runs an e-commerce platform specializing in automotive parts for RAM and Ford trucks. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company curates and sells a range of replacement parts and maintenance kits, focusing on filtration, wiper blades, and lighting. Its catalog includes air filters, fuel filters, cabin air filters, and filter maintenance kits for Cummins diesel engines, as well as wiper blades for Ford F-Series trucks and lighting products under the M&R Automotive Lights brand. The business operates as an online retailer, shipping orders directly to customers.

The primary customer base consists of owners and service shops maintaining RAM and Ford diesel trucks, particularly those with 6.7L Cummins engines. The product selection targets routine maintenance needs such as oil changes and filter replacements. The company also serves Spanish-speaking customers through a bilingual website.

OEM Car Parts USA emphasizes guaranteed fitment, free shipping on filter orders, and a money-back guarantee as key differentiators. The site promotes hassle-free returns and 100% satisfaction assurance to reduce purchase risk for buyers.
